Name: Amasa, Son of Abigail
Summary: Son of Abigail, David's sister, by Jether the Ishmeelite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:17: Son of Abigail, David's sister, by Jether the Ishmeelite.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Amasa stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
